**AIHardSoftSuite**
A suite for converting between Illustrator's internal artboard and public page coordinate systems.
- `AIRealPointHarden(srcpoint, dstpoint)`: Converts a point from page to artboard coordinates.
- `AIRealPointSoften(srcpoint, dstpoint)`: Converts a point from artboard to page coordinates.
- `AIRealMatrixHarden(matrix)`: Converts a matrix translation from page to artboard coordinates.
- `AIRealMatrixSoften(matrix)`: Converts a matrix translation from artboard to page coordinates.
- `AIRealMatrixRealHard(matrix)`: Converts a matrix translation from page to artboard coordinates and negates the b and c components.
- `AIRealMatrixRealSoft(matrix)`: Converts a matrix translation from artboard to page coordinates and negates the b and c components.
- `AIRealRectHarden(inRect, outRect)`: Converts a rectangle from page to artboard coordinates.
- `AIRealRectSoften(inRect, outRect)`: Converts a rectangle from artboard to page coordinates.
- `GetCoordinateSystem(coordinateSystem)`: Reports the current coordinate system for API functions.
- `SetCoordinateSystem(coordinateSystem)`: Sets the coordinate system for API functions.
- `ConvertCoordinates(point, src, dest, convertForDisplay)`: Converts a point between coordinate systems.

**AIHitTestSuite**
A suite for finding art objects based on position.
- `HitTest(art, point, option, hit)`: Finds an object in an art tree at a given point.
- `HitTestEx(art, point, tolerance, option, hit)`: Finds an object in an art tree at or near a given point with tolerance.
- `CustomHitTest(art, point, tolerance, option, pluginGroup, extData, hit)`: Finds an object at a point, including custom hit testing for plug-ins.
- `AddRef(hit)`: Increments the reference count of a hit object.
- `Release(hit)`: Decrements the reference count of a hit object and frees it if the count is zero.
- `IsHit(hit)`: Reports whether a hit test found an object.
- `GetHitData(hit, toolHit)`: Retrieves general hit data from a hit object.
- `GetCustomHitData(hit, userdata, pluginObject)`: Retrieves custom hit data from a plug-in group.
- `GetType(hit)`: Retrieves the type of object found by a hit test.
- `GetSubType(hit)`: Retrieves the sub-type of a fill hit.
- `GetArt(hit)`: Retrieves the art object found by a hit test.
- `GetGroup(hit)`: Retrieves the group containing the hit art object.
- `GetPoint(hit)`: Retrieves the exact location of the hit.
- `GetPathSegment(hit)`: For a path hit, returns the segment number.
- `GetPathParameter(hit)`: For a path segment hit, returns the parametric position on the segment.
- `GetSignedHitDistance(hit)`: Finds the signed distance from the mouse-down point to the closest point on a path.
- `GetType(hit)`: Retrieves the type of object found by a successful hit test.
- `HitTest(art, point, option, hit)`: Finds an object in an art tree at a given point, using a default tolerance.
- `HitTestEx(art, point, tolerance, option, hit)`: Finds an object in an art tree at or near a point, allowing a custom tolerance.
- `IsHit(hit)`: Reports whether a search found a matching object.
- `Release(hit)`: Decrements the reference count of a hit object, freeing memory if the count reaches zero.

### Image Optimization Parameter Structures

**AIImageOptGIFParams:** Parameters for GIF image optimization.
- `interlaced` (AIBool8): True if the input image is interlaced.
- `transparencyAvailable` (AIBool8): True if the input image can use transparency.
- `numberOfColors` (ai::int32): Number of colors in the input image [2..255].
- `transparentIndex` (ai::int32): Transparency index of the input image [0..numberOfColors-1].
- `loss` (ai::int32): Degree of lossiness for conversion [0..100].
- `resolution` (AIFloat): Image resolution in pixels per inch.
- `outAlpha` (AIBool8): True to include an alpha channel in the output image.
- `outWidth` (ai::int32): Width in pixels of the output image.
- `outHeight` (ai::int32): Height in pixels of the output image.

**AIImageOptJPEGParams:** Parameters for JPEG image optimization.
- `quality` (ai::int32): Degree of quality [0..100].
- `kind` (AIImageOptJPEGKind): The type of JPEG to create.
- `scans` (ai::int32): Number of scans; greater than one implies a progressive JPEG.
- `blurAmount` (AIFloat): Degree of blur [0..2].
- `resolution` (AIFloat): Image resolution in pixels per inch.
- `outAlpha` (AIBool8): True to include an alpha channel in the output image.
- `outWidth` (ai::int32): Width in pixels of the output image.
- `outHeight` (ai::int32): Height in pixels of the output image.

**AIImageOptPNGParams:** Parameters for PNG image optimization.
- `interlaced` (AIBool8): True if the input image is interlaced.
- `numberOfColors` (ai::int32): Number of colors in the input image [2..255].
- `transparentIndex` (ai::int32): Transparency index of the input image [0..numberOfColors-1].
- `resolution` (AIFloat): Image resolution in pixels per inch.
- `outAlpha` (AIBool8): True to include an alpha channel in the output image.
- `outWidth` (ai::int32): Width in pixels of the output image.
- `outHeight` (ai::int32): Height in pixels of the output image.

**AIImageOptPNGParams2:** Additional PNG parameters for image optimization.
- `versionOneSuiteParams` (AIImageOptPNGParams): Version 1 parameters.
- `antialias` (ASInt32): Antialiasing mode: 0 (none), 1 (ignore text settings), 2 (optimize for text).
- `cropBox` (AIRealRect): A cropping box for the art; empty or degenerate means no crop.
- `backgroundIsTransparent` (AIBool8): True to rasterize against a transparent background.
- `matteColor` (AIRGBColor): The matte color to rasterize against if the background is not transparent.

### AIImageOptSuite Functions

- `AsGIF(aiArt, aiDataFilter, params)`: Rasterizes art to GIF format.
- `AsJPEG(aiArt, aiDataFilter, params)`: Rasterizes art to JPEG format.
- `AsPNG(aiArt, aiDataFilter, params)`: Rasterizes art to PNG24 format.
- `AsZLIB(aiArt, aiDataFilter, params)`: Rasterizes art to ZLIB format.
- `MakePNG24(aiArt, aiDataFilter, params, progressProc)`: Rasterizes art to PNG24 with extended parameters and a progress callback.
- `CreatePalette(raster, options, palette)`: Creates a color palette for art.
- `DisposePalette(palette)`: Frees the memory for a palette object.
- `GetPaletteColor(palette, index, color)`: Retrieves a color from a palette by index.
- `SetPaletteColor(palette, index, color)`: Sets a color in a palette by index.
- `CreateInversePalette(palette, inverse)`: Creates an inverse color palette for color lookups.
- `DisposeInversePalette(inverse)`: Frees the memory for an inverse palette object.
- `GetPaletteIndex(inverse, color, index)`: Retrieves the index of the closest color match from an inverse palette.
- `CreateReducedPalette(colorList, colorListCount, reduceColorCount, palette)`: Creates a reduced color palette by posterizing a list of colors.
- `AIImageOptZLIBParams`: ZLIB parameters for image optimization with members:
  - `level`: Optimization level (no optimization, or optimize for speed or size)
  - `resolution`: Image resolution in pixels per inch
  - `outAlpha`: Include alpha channel when true
  - `outWidth`: Output image width in pixels
  - `outHeight`: Output image height in pixels

- `AIIntertwineSuite`: Contains function:
  - `IsIntertwined(inGroup)`: Checks if art object is of type intertwine

- `AIIsolationModeChangedNotifierData`: Data sent with isolation mode change notifications:
  - `inIsolationMode`: True if entering isolation mode
  - `isolatedArt`: The isolated art object
  - `isolatedArtParent`: Parent of the isolated art
  - `canceled`: True if exited via Cancel operation

- `AIIsolationModeSuite`: Handles isolation mode operations with functions:
  - `EnterIsolationMode(art, invisibleFlag)`: Enters isolation mode for art
  - `ExitIsolationMode()`: Exits isolation mode
  - `GetIsolatedArtAndParents(isolatedArtParent, parentChain)`: Retrieves original parent and ancestors
  - `IsInIsolationMode()`: Reports if isolation mode is active
  - `IsIsolatedLayer(art)`: Reports if art is in isolated layer
  - `IsNonIsolatedLayer(art)`: Reports if art is in non-isolated layer
  - `CanIsolateArt(art)`: Reports if art can be isolated
  - `GetIsolationModeType()`: Returns type of isolation mode
  - `CancelIsolationMode()`: Exits with canceled flag set
  - `SetNonIsolatedArtLayerOpacity(inNewOpacity)`: Sets opacity for non-isolated layers
  - `GetNonIsolatedArtLayerOpacity()`: Gets current opacity value
  - `GetArtToIsolate(art)`: Gets art handle to isolate

- `AIKnot`: Represents a knot in a flattened path with members:
  - `lengthFromLastKnot`: Distance in points from previous knot
  - `fractionalLengthAlongPath`: Fractional distance from path start [0.0..1.0]

- `AILabColorStyle`: Lab color representation with members:
  - `l`, `a`, `b`: Lab color components
  - `Init()`: Initializes color values

- `AILabColorStyleMap`: Valid fields indicator for partial Lab color with members:
  - `l`, `a`, `b`: Boolean flags for valid components
  - `Init()`: Initializes flags

- `AILayerListMessage`: Contains layer list message data with members:
  - `d`, `data`, `list`: Message data fields
- `AILayerListMessage`: Contains layer list message data with members:
  - `d`: `SPMessageData` for the message
  - `list`: The `AILayerList` being pushed, popped, or deleted
  - `data`: Data passed from `AILayerListSuite::Push()`

- `AILayerListSuite`: Manages a stack of layer lists for an Illustrator document with functions for:
  - Stack Management: `Push()`, `Pop()`
  - List Iteration: `GetFirst()`, `GetLast()`, `GetNext()`, `Count()`
  - Layer Access: `GetLayerOfArt()`, `GetFirstLayer()`, `GetLastLayer()`, `GetNextLayer()`, `GetPrevLayer()`, `CountLayers()`
  - List Properties: `GetTag()`, `GetDisplayMode()`, `SetDisplayMode()`, `GetEditabilityMode()`, `SetEditabilityMode()`

- `AILayerSuite`: Manages and accesses layers within the current layer list with functions for:
  - Layer Management: `CountLayers()`, `GetCurrentLayer()`, `GetLayerByTitle()`, `InsertLayer()`, `DeleteLayer()`, `SetCurrentLayer()`
  - Layer Properties: `GetLayer...`/`SetLayer...` for title, visibility, editability, color, template, printing, and dimming.
  - Layer Hierarchy: `GetLayerParent()`, `GetLayerFirstChild()`, `ChangeLayerToGroup()`, `GetNext...Layer()` functions.
  - Art Selection: `SelectArtOnLayer()`, `DeselectArtOnLayer()`, `LayerHasArt()`, `LayerHasSelectedArt()`
The `AILayerSuite` provides functions to manage and manipulate layers in an Illustrator document.

- **Layer Access and Iteration**
  - `CountLayers(count)`: Gets the number of top-level layers.
  - `GetNthLayer(n, layer)`: Gets a top-level layer by its index.
  - `GetFirstLayer(first)`: Gets the topmost layer.
  - `GetNextLayer(prev, next)`: Gets the next sibling layer below the given one.
  - `GetPrevLayer(next, prev)`: Gets the previous sibling layer above the given one.
  - `GetLayerByTitle(layer, title)`: Finds a layer by its name.

- **Layer Creation, Deletion, and Activation**
  - `GetCurrentLayer(layer)`: Gets the current layer.
  - `SetCurrentLayer(layer)`: Sets the current layer.
  - `InsertLayer(layer, paintOrder, newLayer)`: Inserts a new layer relative to another layer.
  - `InsertLayerAtArt(art, paintOrder, newLayer)`: Inserts a new layer relative to an art object.
  - `DeleteLayer(layer)`: Deletes a layer and all its contained art.

- **Layer Properties (Get/Set)**
  - `GetLayerTitle/SetLayerTitle(layer, title)`: Gets or sets the layer's name.
  - `GetLayerColor/SetLayerColor(layer, color)`: Gets or sets the color for outlining selected art.
  - `GetLayerVisible/SetLayerVisible(layer, visible)`: Gets or sets the layer's visibility.
  - `GetLayerPreview/SetLayerPreview(layer, preview)`: Gets or sets preview/outline mode.
  - `GetLayerEditable/SetLayerEditable(layer, editable)`: Gets or sets whether the layer is editable (unlocked).
  - `GetLayerPrinted/SetLayerPrinted(layer, printed)`: Gets or sets whether the layer is printable.
  - `GetLayerDimPlacedImages/SetLayerDimPlacedImages(layer, dimmed)`: Gets or sets whether placed images are dimmed.
  - `GetLayerDimmedPercent/SetLayerDimmedPercent(layer, percent)`: Gets or sets the image dimming percentage (0-100).
  - `GetLayerSelected/SetLayerSelected(layer, selected)`: Gets or sets the layer's selected state.
  - `GetLayerIsTemplate/SetLayerIsTemplate(layer, isTemplate)`: Gets or sets the layer's template status.

- **Layer Hierarchy**
  - `GetLayerParent(layer, parent)`: Gets the parent of a layer.
  - `GetLayerFirstChild(layer, child)`: Gets the first sublayer of a layer.
  - `ChangeLayerToGroup(layer, group)`: Converts a sublayer into a simple art group.

- **Layer Traversal**
  - `GetNextPreorderLayer(prev, next)`: Traverses layers in preorder (descendents first, then siblings).
  - `GetNextNonChildPreorderLayer(prev, next)`: Traverses to the next sibling in preorder, skipping descendants.

- **Art Selection on Layers**
  - `LayerHasArt(layer, hasArt)`: Checks if a layer contains art objects.
  - `LayerHasSelectedArt(layer, hasSel)`: Checks if a layer contains selected art.
  - `SelectArtOnLayer(layer)`: Selects all selectable art on a layer.
  - `DeselectArtOnLayer(layer)`: Deselects all art on a layer.
- SetLayerVisible(layer, visible): Sets the visibility status of a layer, which affects whether the artwork is drawn. If a parent layer's visibility is false, artwork of a sublayer is not drawn, even if the sublayer's visibility is true.
- **AILiveEditSuite**: Manages live editing of art, allowing tools to participate in a mode where appearances are rendered interactively.
  - IsLiveEditingAdvisable(): Reports if interactive art manipulation is in Live Editing mode.
  - IsLiveEditingAbandoned(): Reports if interactive art manipulation is in abandoned mode.
  - RegisterLiveEditPluginTool(inPluginTool, inFeatureName, inEPFOverrideValue): Registers a plugin tool for live editing, which automatically calls change notification functions.
    - `inPluginTool`: Tool handle.
    - `inFeatureName`: Unique feature name. Cannot be empty.
    - `inEPFOverrideValue`: Event processing frequency override value. Use `kUseGlobaLimitValue` for the default.
  - DeregisterLiveEditPluginTool(inPluginTool): Deregisters a tool from live editing.
    - `inPluginTool`: Tool handle.
  - ChangeBeginNotify(inFeatureName, inEPFOverrideValue): Called by a widget at the start of an interactive manipulation session (mouse-down). Must be balanced with `ChangeFinishNotify()`.
    - `inFeatureName`: Unique feature name.
    - `inEPFOverrideValue`: Event processing frequency override value.
  - ChangeContinueStartNotify(): Called at the start of a change event (mouse-drag). Must be balanced with `ChangeContinueEndNotify()`.
  - ChangeContinueEndNotify(): Called at the end of a change event (mouse-drag). Must be balanced with `ChangeContinueStartNotify()`.
  - ChangeFinishNotify(): Called at the end of the manipulation session (mouse-up). Must be balanced with `ChangeBeginNotify()`.
  - SuspendLiveEditing(): Temporarily suspends a live editing session. Must be balanced with `ResumeLiveEditing()`.
  - ResumeLiveEditing(): Resumes a suspended live editing session. Must be balanced with `SuspendLiveEditing()`.
- **AILiveEffectAdjustColorsMessage**: Sent with `kSelectorAILiveEffectAdjustColors` to allow another plug-in to modify private color data stored in an effect's parameters.
  - `d`: Standard message data.
  - `effect`: The effect object.
  - `parameters`: The effect's current parameter block.
  - `adjustColorCallback`: Callback to adjust colors, supplied by another plug-in.
  - `adjustPatternHandleCallback`: Callback to adjust patterns, supplied by another plug-in.
  - `clientData`: Private data for the callback.
  - `controlFlags`: Bit flags controlling which colors are passed to the callback.
  - `modifiedSomething`: [out] Set to `true` if the handler modified any colors.
- **AILiveEffectConvertColorMessage**: Sent with a request to convert private color data stored in a dictionary to a new color space. Normal fill/stroke colors are converted automatically.
  - `d`: Standard message data.
  - `effect`: The effect object.
  - `parameters`: The effect's current parameter block.
  - `newColorSpace`: The new color space.
- **AILiveEffectData**: Information for registering a Live Effect with `AILiveEffectSuite::AddLiveEffect()`.
  - `self`: The plug-in registering the effect.
  - `name`: Unique, non-localized effect name.
  - `title`: Localized display title.
  - `majorVersion`: Plug-in's major version number.
  - `minorVersion`: Plug-in's minor version number.
  - `prefersAsInput`: The type of art this effect operates on (`AIStyleFilterPreferredInputArtType`).
  - `styleFilterFlags`: Bit flags (`AIStyleFilterFlags`) specifying the effect's type and features.
- **AILiveEffectEditParamMessage**: Sent when the user creates or edits an effect. The plug-in should collect parameter values, optionally previewing the effect with `UpdateParameters()`.
  - `d`: Standard message data.
  - `effect`: The effect object.
  - `parameters`: [in, out] The effect's parameters. Modify as needed.
  - `context`: The parameter context.
  - `allowPreview`: `true` if preview is enabled.
  - `isNewInstance`: `true` if this is the first time the effect is applied, `false` if it's being modified.
- **AILiveEffectGetSVGFilterMessage**: Sent with a request to obtain an SVG filter representation of an effect, if the effect has indicated it can do so.
  - `d`: Standard message data.
  - `effect`: The effect object.
  - `parameters`: The effect's current parameter block.
  - `svgFilter`: [out] Set to the SVG filter object.
- **AILiveEffectGoMessage**: Sent to run the effect on art after parameters have been collected.
  - `d`: Standard message data.
  - `effect`: The effect object.
  - `parameters`: The effect's parameters.
  - `instanceInfo`: [in, out] Stored parameters from a previous invocation on this object.
  - `art`: [in, out] The art object to edit. Do not modify ancestors or the document tree. The plug-in is responsible for deleting removed source art objects. Set to `NULL` to have Illustrator dispose of the input art.
  - `srcArt`: [in] The source art on which the effect is applied, for storing information for later use.
- **AILiveEffectHandleMergeMessage**: Sent to a plug-in that initiated a merge with `MergeLiveEffectIntoSelection()`, allowing it to handle the merge operation.
  - `d`: Standard message data.
  - `effect`: The effect object.
  - `oldEffect`: The effect object currently in use, if any. `NULL` if replacing a default fill/stroke.
  - `dontMerge`: [out] Set to `true` to prevent the merge.
  - `keepInstanceInfo`: [out] Set to `true` to preserve instance information from the existing effect.
  - `parameters`: [in, out] The parameter block for the existing effect, if any. Modify in place. If `NULL`, the Edit message is sent to collect parameters.
- **AILiveEffectInputTypeMessage**: Sent when an effect with `kInputArtDynamic` input type is selected, to determine the required input art type based on the selected art.
  - `d`: Standard message data.
  - `effect`: The effect object.
  - `parameters`: The effect's current parameter block.
  - `inputArt`: The art object whose type is to be computed.
  - `typeMask`: [out] The type of art this effect can operate on with the current parameters (`AIStyleFilterPreferredInputArtType`). Set to `kAnyInputArt` if the effect can handle the input art, otherwise set to the desired conversion type.
- **AILiveEffectInterpParamMessage**: Sent when a user blends objects with Live Effects to interpolate parameters for intermediate objects.
  - `d`: [in] Standard message data.
  - `effect`: [in] The effect object.
  - `startParams`: [in] A parameter block for the starting point.
  - `endParams`: [in] A parameter block for the ending point.
  - `outParams`: [out] A parameter block to contain the interpolated result.
  - `percent`: [in] A percentage (0-1) of the distance between start and end points.

- **AILiveEffectIsCompatibleMessage**: Sent when saving a file to check for legacy compatibility, if the `kHandlesIsCompatibleMsg` flag is set.
  - `d`: [in] Standard message data.
  - `effect`: [in] The effect object.
  - `appVersion`: [in] The application version to check against.
  - `parameters`: [in] The effect's current parameter block.
  - `compatible`: [out] Set to `true` if compatible with `appVersion`.

- **AILiveEffectParallelExecutionData**: Information supplied when registering a Live Effect for Parallel Execution with `AILiveEffectSuite::AddLiveEffect()`.
  - `parallelExecutionArtFlags`: A logical OR of `AIParallelExecutionArtFlags` specifying supported art types.

- **AILiveEffectScaleParamMessage**: Sent with a request to scale effect parameters.
  - `d`: [in] Standard message data.
  - `effect`: [in] The effect object.
  - `parameters`: [in, out] The current parameters. Modify in place.
  - `scaleFactor`: [in] The scaling factor (e.g., 1.0 for 100%).
  - `scaledParams`: [out] Set to `true` if the parameters were modified.

- **AILiveEffectSuite**: A suite for implementing Live Effects, which are filters attached to art objects that re-execute when the art is changed.
  - `AddLiveEffect`: Registers a new Live Effect.
  - `AddLiveEffectFilterItem`: Adds a menu item for an effect using a predefined filter.
  - `AddLiveEffectMenuItem`: Adds a menu item for an effect.
  - `CountLiveEffects`: Returns the number of registered effects.
  - `CreateLiveEffectParameters`: Creates a parameter dictionary for constructing a style.
  - `GetInputPreference`: Gets the preferred input art types for an effect.
  - `GetLiveEffectAppVersion`, `SetLiveEffectAppVersion`: Gets/sets the earliest supported Illustrator version for an effect.
  - `GetLiveEffectHandleByName`: Retrieves an effect by its unique name.
  - `GetLiveEffectName`: Gets an effect's unique name.
  - `GetLiveEffectTitle`: Gets an effect's localizable display name.
  - `GetLiveEffectVersion`: Gets an effect's version number.
  - `GetMenuItem`: Retrieves the menu item that invoked the effect (during an Edit message).
  - `GetNthLiveEffect`: Retrieves an effect by index.
  - `GetStyleFilterFlags`: Gets the style flags for an effect.
  - `InterpolateEffectParameters`: Interpolates parameters for an effect.
  - `MergeLiveEffectIntoSelection`: Merges an effect into the style of all selected objects.
  - `NewArtStyleByMergingLiveEffect`: Creates a new art style by merging an effect into an existing style.
  - `SetLiveEffectParallelExecutionData`: Provides parallel execution data for a registered effect.
  - `UpdateParameters`: Updates artwork after parameter changes when preview is enabled.
- `SetLiveEffectAppVersion`: Sets the earliest Illustrator version an effect supports for RGB and CMYK documents.
- `SetLiveEffectParallelExecutionData`: Provides data to customize parallel execution behavior for an effect.
- `UpdateParameters`: Updates artwork after parameter changes when effect preview is enabled.

- `Transform`: Transforms mesh points using a transformation matrix.

### AIPathSuite

This suite provides functions to examine and manipulate paths, which are art objects of type `kPathArt`.

#### Member List
- `BezierPosToAnchoredPos`
- `BezierPosToLengthFraction`
- `CancelKeySegment`
- `DeletePathSegments`
- `GetKeySegment`
- `GetPathAllSegmentsSelected`
- `GetPathArea`
- `GetPathBezier`
- `GetPathClosed`
- `GetPathGuide`
- `GetPathIsClip`
- `GetPathLength`
- `GetPathSegmentCount`
- `GetPathSegments`
- `GetPathSegmentSelected`
- `GetPathSegmentsSelected`
- `InsertPathSegments`
- `IsPath9SliceSplitter`
- `LengthFractionToBezierPos`
- `MeasureSegments`
- `PathHasLength`
- `PerpendicularsAtBezierT`
- `ReversePathDirection`
- `ReversePathSegments`
- `SetKeySegment`
- `SetPathAllSegmentsSelected`
- `SetPathClosed`
- `SetPathGuide`
- `SetPathSegmentCount`
- `SetPathSegments`
- `SetPathSegmentSelected`
- `SetPathSegmentsSelected`
`AIPathSuite`: Provides functions to examine and manipulate path art objects (`kPathArt`). A path's shape is defined by segments, each corresponding to an anchor point. Segments are defined by the `AIPathSegment` structure. Paths can be open or closed, and some are used as guides. Acquire using `SPBasicSuite::AcquireSuite()` with `kAIPathSuite` and `kAIPathVersion`.

-   `GetPathSegmentCount`: Gets the number of anchor points (segments) on a path, including the two at each end. Params: `path` (The path object), `count` (out, buffer for the number of segments).
-   `SetPathSegmentCount`: Removes or appends segments to a path to reach a new count. Params: `path` (The path object), `count` (The new segment count). Returns `kTooManySegmentsErr` if the new count exceeds the maximum. Note: Useful for freeing memory from unused segments allocated by `NewArt()`.
-   `GetPathSegments`: Retrieves a set of segments from a path. Params: `path` (The path object), `segNumber` (0-based index of first segment), `count` (number of segments to retrieve), `segments` (out, pre-allocated array to return segments in).
-   `SetPathSegments`: Adds or updates segments in a path. Params: `path` (The path object), `segNumber` (0-based index of first segment), `count` (number of segments to add), `segments` (array of new segments). Returns `kTooManySegmentsErr`.
-   `InsertPathSegments`: Inserts segments into a path after a specified segment. Params: `path`, `segNumber` (insert after this one), `count`, `segments` (array of new segments). Returns `kTooManySegmentsErr`.
-   `DeletePathSegments`: Deletes segments from a path. Params: `path`, `segNumber` (0-based index of first segment), `count`.
-   `GetPathClosed`: Reports whether a path is closed. Params: `path`, `closed` (out, true if closed).
-   `SetPathClosed`: Opens or closes a path. Params: `path`, `closed` (true to close).
-   `GetPathGuide`: Reports whether a path is used as a guide. Params: `path`, `isGuide` (out, true if guide).
-   `SetPathGuide`: Sets whether a path is used as a guide. Params: `path`, `isGuide` (true if guide).
-   `GetPathSegmentSelected`: Reports if any part of a path segment is selected. Params: `path`, `segNumber`, `selected` (out, `AIPathSegementSelectionState`).
-   `GetPathSegmentsSelected`: Reports selection state of multiple path segments. Params: `path`, `segNumber`, `count`, `selected` (out, pre-allocated array of `AIPathSegementSelectionState`).
-   `SetPathSegmentSelected`: Sets selection state for a segment. Params: `path`, `segNumber`, `selected` (new `AIPathSegementSelectionState`). Note: Modifying one segment can affect adjacent ones.
-   `SetPathSegmentsSelected`: Sets selection state for multiple segments. Params: `path`, `segNumber`, `count`, `selected` (array of new `AIPathSegementSelectionState`). Note: Can affect adjacent segments.
-   `GetPathAllSegmentsSelected`: Reports if all segments of a path are selected. Params: `path`, `selected` (out, true if fully selected).
-   `SetPathAllSegmentsSelected`: Sets selection state for all segments of a path. Params: `path`, `selected` (new `AIPathSegementSelectionState`). Note: Can affect adjacent segments.
-   `ReversePathSegments`: Reverses the order of segments in a path. Params: `path`. Note: Affects winding order, significant for compound paths.
-   `ReversePathDirection`: Reverses the direction of a path. Params: `path`. Note: For open paths, same as `ReversePathSegments`. For closed paths, transformation is different and can affect appearance with variable width, arrowheads, etc.
-   `GetPathArea`: Calculates the area of a path. Params: `path`, `area` (out, area in square points). Note: Sign of area indicates winding order (negative = counter-clockwise).
-   `GetPathLength`: Calculates the perimeter length of a path. Params: `path`, `length` (out, length in points), `flatness` (not used).
-   `GetPathBezier`: Calculates the bezier values of a path segment. Params: `path`, `segNumber`, `bezier` (out, bezier values). Note: For the last segment of an open path, wraps to the beginning. For the last segment of a closed path, all four bezier points are equal.
-   `PathHasLength`: Reports if a path has length (more efficient than checking `GetPathLength()` != 0). Params: `path`, `hasLength` (out, true if length is not zero).
-   `GetPathIsClip`: Reports if a path is a clipping path. Params: `path`, `isClip` (out, true if clipping path). Note: Path can be a compound path and must have at least two segments.
-   `GetKeySegment`: Retrieves the path object and segment number of the key anchor point (the one to which others are aligned). Params: `path` (out, path object), `segmentNumber` (out, segment number).
-   `CancelKeySegment`: [Deprecated] Clears the key anchor point. Use `SetKeySegment()` instead.
-   `SetKeySegment`: Sets the key anchor point of an art object. Params: `path` (art object, or NULL to use selected art), `segmentNumber` (segment index, ignored if `path` is NULL). Returns `kBadParameterErr` if no anchor is selected and `path` is NULL.
-   `MeasureSegments`: Measures the lengths of path segments. Params: `path`, `startSeg`, `count`, `pieceLengths` (out, optional, length of each segment), `accumulatedLengths` (out, optional, length from start through each segment). Note: Storage managed by client.
-   `LengthFractionToBezierPos`: Computes the segment index and bezier `t` value for a point at a given fraction of the total path length. Params: `path`, `lengthFraction`, `segIndex` (out), `bezierT` (out), `pieceLengths` (in, optional), `accumulatedLengths` (in, optional). Note: Optional params improve performance for repeated calls.
-   `BezierPosToLengthFraction`: Computes the fraction of the total path length for a position given by a segment index and bezier `t` value. Params: `path`, `segIndex`, `bezierT`, `lengthFraction` (out), `pieceLengths` (in, optional), `accumulatedLengths` (in, optional). Note: Optional params improve performance.
-   `BezierPosToAnchoredPos`: Converts a parametric bezier `t` value to a fraction of the segment length. Params: `path`, `segIndex`, `t`, `segLength` (optional, in/out), `segLengthFraction` (out). Note: `segLength` can be passed in for performance.
-   `PerpendicularsAtBezierT`: Computes endpoints of line segments perpendicular to a path at a given position. Params: `path`, `segIndex`, `t`, `leftDistance`, `rightDistance`, `pointOnPath` (out), `leftPoint` (out, optional), `rightPoint` (out, optional). Note: Distances must be non-negative.
-   `IsPath9SliceSplitter`: Reports if a path is a 9-slice splitter (a guide defining 9 art board regions). Params: `path`. Returns true if it is.

`AIPathfinderData`: Defines how to perform a pathfinder operation. Members: `options` (operation control options), `parameters` (mixing/trapping parameters), `fSelectedArt` (array of art objects), `fSelectedArtCount` (count of art objects), `fOutputArt`, `fAlertInfoID` (not used, pass 0). Includes `Init()` to set default values.

`AIPathfinderMessage`: Contents of a Pathfinder message. Members: `d` (message data), `pathfinderData` (operation data).

`AIPathfinderSuite`: Performs path operations corresponding to the Pathfinder palette and Effect menu. Also manipulates compound shapes (plug-in groups). Acquire using `SPBasicSuite::AcquireSuite()` with `kAIPathfinderSuite` and `kAIPathfinderVersion`.

-   `DoUniteEffect`, `DoIntersectEffect`, `DoExcludeEffect`, `DoBackMinusFrontEffect`, `DoFrontMinusBackEffect`, `DoDivideEffect`, `DoOutlineEffect`, `DoTrimEffect`, `DoMergeEffect`, `DoCropEffect`, `DoHardEffect`, `DoSoftEffect`, `DoTrapEffect`: Applies the specified pathfinder effect to selected art. Params: `data` (`AIPathfinderData` with selected art), `message` (not used, pass NULL).
-   `GetHardEffectParameters`, `GetSoftEffectParameters`, `GetTrapEffectParameters`, `GetGlobalOptions`: Retrieves parameters for the specified effect or global options. Params: `data`, `message` (not used, pass NULL).
-   `GetShapeMode`: Retrieves the compound shape mode for a plug-in group art object. Params: `art`. Returns `AIShapeMode`.
-   `SetShapeMode`: Sets the compound shape mode for a plug-in group art object. Params: `art`, `mode`.
-   `NewCompoundShape`: Creates a new, empty compound shape at a specified position in the art tree. Params: `paintOrder`, `prep`, `newArt` (out, the new art).
-   `IsCompoundShape`: Reports if an art object is a compound shape. Params: `art`, `isCompoundShape` (out, true if it is).
-   `FlattenArt`: Expands a shape into a single path or compound path by applying the Unite effect to each component. Params: `inOutArt` (in/out, the art to flatten).
- `DoTrimEffect`: Applies a Trim effect to selected art. Params: `data` (structure with selected art and operation params), `message` (not used, pass NULL).
- `DoUniteEffect`: Applies a Unite effect to selected art. Params: `data`, `message` (not used, pass NULL).
- `GetGlobalOptions`: Retrieves global options for Pathfinder and Effect operations. Params: `data` (out, relevant parameters), `message` (not used, pass NULL).
- `GetHardEffectParameters`: Retrieves parameters for the Hard effect pathfinder operation. Params: `data` (out, relevant parameters), `message` (not used, pass NULL).
- `GetSoftEffectParameters`: Retrieves parameters for the Soft effect pathfinder operation. Params: `data` (out, relevant parameters), `message` (not used, pass NULL).
- `GetTrapEffectParameters`: Retrieves parameters for the Trap effect pathfinder operation. Params: `data` (out, relevant parameters), `message` (not used, pass NULL).
- `AIPattern`: Obsolete struct. Member: `not_implemented` (`AIBoolean`).
- `AIPatternStyle`: Defines a pattern instance, an application of a pattern to an art object. Members: `pattern` (opaque reference), `shiftDist` (translate distance), `shiftAngle` (translate angle), `scale` (scale fraction), `rotate` (rotation angle), `reflect` (reflection flag), `reflectAngle` (reflection axis), `shearAngle` (shear angle), `shearAxis` (shear axis), `transform` (additional transformation matrix).
- `AIPatternStyleMap`: Defines valid fields of a partial pattern style. Members are `AIBoolean` flags corresponding to `AIPatternStyle` fields.
- `AIPatternSuite`: Functions to create, delete, and modify patterns.
    - `CountPatterns`: Gets the number of patterns in the current document. Params: `count` (out).
    - `DeletePattern`: Deletes a pattern. Params: `pattern`.
    - `GetNthPattern`: Retrieves a pattern by index. Params: `n`, `pattern` (out).
    - `GetPattern`: Copies a pattern's source art into the current document. Params: `pattern`.
    - `GetPatternArt`: Gets the art object that defines a pattern's source. Params: `pattern`, `art` (out).
    - `GetPatternByName`: Retrieves a pattern by name. Params: `name`, `pattern` (out).
    - `GetPatternEditMode`: Reports if PatternEditMode is active. Params: `patternUnderEdit` (in/out), `isolatedPatternArt` (out). Returns `AIBoolean`.
    - `GetPatternName`: Retrieves a pattern's name. Params: `pattern`, `name` (out).
    - `GetPatternTileBounds`: Retrieves a pattern's tile bounds. Params: `pattern`, `bounds` (out).
    - `IteratePattern`: Renders a path filled with a pattern, calling a procedure for each tile. Params: `art`, `style`, `proc`.
    - `NewPattern`: Creates a new pattern object. Params: `newPattern` (out).
    - `NewPatternName`: Creates a unique name for a pattern. Params: `newName` (in/out).
    - `SetPattern`: Makes selected artwork the source for a pattern. Params: `pattern`.
    - `SetPatternArt`: Sets the source art for a pattern. Params: `pattern`, `art`.
    - `SetPatternName`: Sets a pattern's name. Params: `pattern`, `name`.
    - `ValidatePattern`: Reports if a pattern object is valid. Params: `pattern`. Returns `AIBoolean`.
- `AIPerspectiveGridSuite`: Functions to query and set perspective grid parameters.
    - `ArtworkPointToPGPoint`: Converts artwork coordinates to perspective grid coordinates. Params: `pt` (in/out), `plane`.
    - `GetActiveGridType`: Gets the type of the perspective grid. Params: `out_gridType` (out).
    - `GetActivePlane`: Gets the active plane of the perspective grid. Params: `out_gridPlaneType` (out).
    - `GetGridSnapTolerance`: Gets the grid's snapping tolerance. Params: `snapTolerance` (out).
    - `GetPGRulerUnit`: Gets the grid's ruler unit. Params: `unit` (out).
    - `IsGridDefined`: Reports if a perspective grid is defined. Returns `AIBoolean`.
    - `IsGridLocked`: Reports if the perspective grid is locked. Returns `AIBoolean`.
    - `IsGridRulerVisible`: Reports if the grid's rulers are visible. Returns `AIBoolean`.
    - `IsGridStationPointLocked`: Reports if the grid's station point is locked. Returns `AIBoolean`.
    - `IsGridVisible`: Reports if the perspective grid is visible. Returns `AIBoolean`.
    - `IsSnapToGridEnabled`: Reports if snap-to-grid is enabled. Returns `AIBoolean`.
    - `LockGrid`: Locks or unlocks the perspective grid. Params: `flag`.
    - `LockGridStationPoint`: Locks or unlocks the grid's station point. Params: `flag`.
    - `PGPointToArtworkPoint`: Converts perspective grid coordinates to artwork coordinates. Params: `pt` (in/out), `plane`.
    - `SetActivePlane`: Sets the active plane of the perspective grid. Params: `gridPlane`.
    - `SetDefaultPreset`: Sets the default two-point grid preset as active.
    - `ShowGrid`: Shows or hides the perspective grid. Params: `flag`.
    - `ShowGridRuler`: Shows or hides the grid's rulers. Params: `flag`.
    - `SnapToGrid`: Enables or disables snap-to-grid. Params: `flag`.
    - `SwitchActivePlane`: Switches between grid planes.
    - `SwitchActivePlaneFromKB`: Switches between grid planes using keyboard shortcuts.
- `GetPGRulerUnit`: Retrieves the ruler unit. Params: `unit` (out).
- `IsGridDefined`: Reports if a grid is defined. Returns: Boolean.
- `IsGridLocked`: Reports if the grid is locked. Returns: Boolean.
- `IsGridRulerVisible`: Reports if grid rulers are visible. Returns: Boolean.
- `IsGridStationPointLocked`: Reports if the grid's station point is locked. Returns: Boolean.
- `IsGridVisible`: Reports if the grid is visible. Returns: Boolean.
- `IsSnapToGridEnabled`: Reports if snap-to-grid is enabled. Returns: Boolean.

### AIPerspectiveTransformSuite
This suite projects or reverse-projects points and art objects using the perspective grid.
- `ApplyTransformInPerspective`: Transforms art into perspective using a matrix. Params: `art`, `transform`. Returns: Boolean.
- `AttachArtToPerspective`: Attaches art to the perspective grid. Params: `art` (or NULL for selection).
- `CanAttachToPerspective`: Reports if art can be attached to the grid. Params: `art`. Returns: Boolean.
- `CanReleaseFromPerspective`: Reports if art can be released from the grid. Params: `art`. Returns: Boolean.
- `ConstrainPtsInPlane`: Places two points in perspective with each other on a plane. Params: `startPt` (in/out), `endPt` (in/out), `gridPlane`, `offset` (out).
- `GetObjectPlane`: Gets the perspective plane for art. Params: `art`, `objectPlane` (out).
- `GetObjectPlaneOffset`: Gets the offset of art on its perspective plane. Params: `art`. Returns: `AIReal`.
- `GetOriginalArt`: Reverse-projects art from perspective. Params: `art` (in/out). Returns: Boolean.
- `GetOriginalArtBounds`: Gets the perspective bounds of art. Params: `art`, `flags`, `bounds` (out).
- `GetOriginalPoint`: Reverse-projects a point from perspective. Params: `point` (in/out), `activePlane`, `planeOffset`. Returns: Boolean.
- `GetPerspectivePoint`: Projects a point into perspective. Params: `point` (in/out), `activePlane`, `planeOffset`. Returns: Boolean.
- `GetTypeOfPerspectiveObject`: Gets the type of art in a perspective plug-in object. Params: `art`, `type` (out).
- `IsArtInPerspective`: Reports if art is in perspective. Params: `art`. Returns: Boolean.
- `IsPerspectiveObjectEditingOriginal`: Reports if the original art of a perspective object is being edited. Params: `art`. Returns: Boolean.
- `IsPerspectivePluginObject`: Reports if art is a perspective plug-in group. Params: `art`. Returns: Boolean.
- `IsSelectionInMultipleOffset`: Reports if selected objects are at different grid offsets. Params: `isMultiOffsetSelection` (out).
- `PlaceArtInPerspective`: Places art in a perspective plane. Params: `art`, `startPoint`, `endPoint`, `plane`.
- `PutInPerspective`: Projects art into perspective. Params: `art` (in/out), `activePlane`, `planeOffset`. Returns: Boolean.
- `ReleaseArtFromPerspective`: Releases art from the perspective grid. Params: `art` (or NULL for selection).

### AIPlaceRequestData
Request data for `AIPlacedSuite::ExecPlaceRequest()`.
- `m_lPlaceMode`: Type of placement request, a `PlaceRequestMode` constant.
- `m_hOldArt`: Art to be replaced.
- `m_hNewArt`: Returns the handle for new art that was placed or created.
- `m_pFilePath`: File path of the placed file. If `NULL`, shows a File Place dialog.
- `m_lParam`: Type of art to create for the `kCreateNewArt` request, an `AIArtType` value.
- `m_filemethod`: 0 to place/import, 1 to link the file.
- `m_disableTemplate`: True to disable the Template placement option.
- `m_doShowParamDialog`: True to show the parameters dialog even when the file path is known.
- `m_PlaceTransformType`: Triggers the desired kind of placement.

### AIPlacedSuite
This suite accesses and manipulates placed art.
- `ConcatPlacedMatrix`: Concatenates a new transformation matrix. Params: `placed`, `concat`.
- `CountPlacedCustomColors`: Gets number of custom colors for an EPS file. Params: `art`, `count` (out).
- `ExecPlaceRequest`: Executes a place request. Params: `placeRequestData`.
- `GetNthPlacedCustomColorName`: Gets name of a custom color for an EPS file. Params: `art`, `num`, `name` (out).
- `GetPlacedBoundingBox`: Gets boundary dimensions of placed art. Params: `placed`, `bbox` (out).
- `GetPlacedChild`: Gets art group for non-EPS linked file. Params: `placed`, `group` (out).
- `GetPlacedDimensions`: Gets size, placement, and transformation. Params: `placed`, `size` (out), `viewBounds` (out), `viewMatrix` (out), `imageBounds` (out), `imageMatrix` (out).
- `GetPlacedFileInfoFromArt`: Gets file info from stored data. Params: `placed`, `spFileInfo` (out).
- `GetPlacedFileInfoFromFile`: Gets file info from the file itself. Params: `placed`, `spFileInfo` (out).
- `GetPlacedFilePathFromArt`: Gets file path for placed art. Params: `placed`, `path` (out).
- `GetPlacedFileSpecification`: Gets file specification for linked file. Params: `placed`, `file` (out).
- `GetPlacedMatrix`: Gets transformation matrix. Params: `placed`, `matrix` (out).
- `GetPlacedType`: Gets type of placed object (EPS or other). Params: `placed`, `pPlacedType` (out).
- `GetPlaceOptions`: Gets placement options. Params: `placed`, `method` (out), `alignment` (out), `clip` (out).
- `GetProcessPlatesInfo`: Gets process color plates for EPS/linked image. Params: `art`, `plateInfo` (out).
- `GetRasterInfo`: Gets raster record for placed linked image. Params: `art`, `info` (out), `israster` (out).
- `IsPlacedFileDamaged`: Reports if linked file is damaged. Params: `art`. Returns: Boolean.
- `IsProxyUsedForRendering`: Reports if proxy is used for rendering. Params: `art`. Returns: Boolean.
- `MakePlacedObjectNative`: Changes linked object to embedded. Params: `placed`, `native` (out), `askForParam`.
- `SetPlacedBoundingBox`: Sets preliminary bounding box. Params: `art`, `bbox`.
- `SetPlacedFileSpecification`: Associates placed object with a linked file. Params: `placed`, `file`.
- `SetPlacedMatrix`: Sets transformation matrix. Params: `placed`, `matrix`.
- `SetPlacedObject`: Creates/clears a group for linked file content. Params: `placed`, `group` (out).
- `SetPlaceOptions`: Sets placement options. Params: `placed`, `method`, `alignment`, `clip`.
- `GetPlacedDimensions`: Retrieves size, placement, and transformation of placed object and linked image. Params: `placed`, `size` (out), `viewBounds` (out), `viewMatrix` (out), `imageBounds` (out), `imageMatrix` (out).
- `GetPlacedFileInfoFromArt`: Retrieves stored file info for linked file. Params: `placed`, `spFileInfo` (out).
- `GetPlacedFileInfoFromFile`: Retrieves current file info from disk. Params: `placed`, `spFileInfo` (out).
- `GetPlacedFilePathFromArt`: Gets file path string. Params: `placed`, `path` (out).
- `GetPlacedFileSpecification`: Gets file specification. Params: `placed`, `file` (out).
- `GetPlacedMatrix`: Gets transformation matrix. Params: `placed`, `matrix` (out).
- `GetPlacedType`: Gets placed object type (EPS or other). Params: `placed`, `pPlacedType` (out).
- `GetPlaceOptions`: Gets placement options. Params: `placed`, `method` (out), `alignment` (out), `clip` (out).
- `GetProcessPlatesInfo`: Gets process color plates info for EPS/linked images. Params: `art`, `plateInfo` (out).
- `GetRasterInfo`: Gets raster record info for linked images. Params: `art`, `info` (out), `israster` (out).

**AIPlanarObjectSuite**  
Works with temporary planar objects to construct planar plug-in groups.  
- `NewPlanarObject`: Begins planar object construction. Params: `matrix`, `gapOptions`.
- `AddPath`: Adds path to planar object. Params: `object`, `segmentCount`, `segments`, `leftFill`, `rightFill`, `stroke`, `closed`.
- `AddPathUniform`: Adds path with uniform styles. Params: `object`, `segmentCount`, `segments`, `leftFill`, `rightFill`, `stroke`, `closed`.

- `CreateArt`: Creates planar plug-in group art. Params: `object`, `paintOrder`, `prep`, `newArt` (out).

- `ComplexConversionCanceled`: Checks if conversion to planar object is feasible. Params: `fromPlanarMap`, `pathOrEdgeCount`, `gapOptions`, `warningDisplayed` (out).
- `EraseBlob`: Erases shape from Live Paint object. Params: `pathBlob`, `planarObject`, `erasedSomething` (out).
- `SelectSimilarFaceStyle`: Selects faces with same fill color.
- `CanSelectSimilarFaceStyle`: Checks if similar face styles can be selected. Returns: Boolean.
- `SelectSimilarEdgeWeights`: Selects edges with same weight.
- `CanSelectSimilarEdgeWeights`: Checks if similar edge weights can be selected. Returns: Boolean.
- `SelectSimilarEdgeColors`: Selects edges with same color.
- `CanSelectSimilarEdgeColors`: Checks if similar edge colors can be selected. Returns: Boolean.

- `Set`: Sets the four control points that define a cubic Bezier. Parameters: `b` (Bezier object), `p0`, `p1`, `p2`, `p3` (control points).
- `Offset`: Translates a cubic Bezier by a vector. Parameters: `b` (Bezier object), `dh` (horizontal vector value), `dv` (vertical vector value).
- `Transform`: Applies a transformation matrix to a cubic Bezier. Parameters: `b` (Bezier object), `m` (transformation matrix).
- `Evaluate`: Finds a point for a given input to a cubic Bezier. Parameters: `b` (Bezier object), `t` (input value), `p` (out, buffer for the point).
- `Tangent`: Finds a tangent for a given input to a cubic Bezier. Parameters: `b` (Bezier object), `t` (input value), `v` (out, buffer for the tangent).
- `Normal`: Finds the normal for a given input to a cubic Bezier. Parameters: `b` (Bezier object), `t` (input value), `v` (out, buffer for the normal).
- `Divide`: Splits a cubic Bezier at a point from a given input value. Parameters: `b` (Bezier object), `t` (input value), `b1` (out, first half Bezier), `b2` (out, second half Bezier).
- `IntersectsRect`: Reports if a cubic Bezier intersects a rectangle. Parameters: `b` (Bezier object), `r` (rectangle), `scale` (bitmap resolution scale factor). Returns a boolean.
- `Length`: Calculates the length of a cubic Bezier curve. Parameters: `b` (Bezier object), `flatness` (accuracy of approximation). Returns the length in points.
- `PointAndTangent`: Finds the point and tangent for a given input to a cubic Bezier. Parameters: `b` (Bezier object), `t` (input value), `p` (out, buffer for point), `v` (out, buffer for tangent).
- `AdjustThroughPoint`: Adjusts a cubic Bezier to pass through a given point at a given input value. Parameters: `b` (Bezier object), `p` (point), `t` (input value). Returns an `AIAdjustThroughPointResult` constant.
- `TAtLength`: Finds the input value that results in a point at a given distance along the curve. Parameters: `bez` (Bezier object), `length` (distance along curve), `total_length` (total curve length), `flatness` (accuracy of approximation), `t` (out, buffer for input value).

**AIRepeat::ConcentricConfig Struct**
Concentric repeat, repeats art in a concentric fashion.
- `numberOfInstances` (`ai::uint32`): Number of instances. Default is 1.
- `mergeState` (`AIRepeatMergeState`): Merge state of the art. Default is `kOverlap`.

**AIRepeat::GridConfig Struct**
Grid repeat, repeats art in a grid fashion.
- `horizontalSpacing` (`AIReal`): Spacing between rows. Default is 10.
- `verticalSpacing` (`AIReal`): Spacing between columns. Default is 10.
- `horizontalOffset` (`AIReal`): Horizontal offset of the first instance. Default is 0.
- `verticalOffset` (`AIReal`): Vertical offset of the first instance. Default is 0.
- `bounds` (`AIRealRect`): Main art bounds.
- `mergeState` (`AIRepeatMergeState`): Merge state of the art. Default is `kOverlap`.
- `patternType` (`AIRepeatGridShiftType`): Shift type of the art. Default is `kNone`.
- `rowFlipType` (`AIRepeatGridFlipType`): Row flip type of the art. Default is `kNone`.
- `columnFlipType` (`AIRepeatGridFlipType`): Column flip type of the art. Default is `kNone`.

**AIRepeat::RadialConfig Struct**
Radial repeat, repeats art in a circular fashion.
- `center` (`AIRealPoint`): Center of the radial repeat art.
- `radius` (`AIReal`): Radius of the radial repeat art. Default is 0.
- `startAngle` (`AIReal`): Start angle of the circular arc. Default is 0.
- `totalAngle` (`AIReal`): Total angle of the circular arc. Default is 0.
- `rotationAlongTheCircle` (`AIReal`): Angle to rotate the object about the center. 0 means base art is at the top (+Y axis). Default is 0.
- `numberOfInstances` (`ai::uint32`): Number of instances. Default is 8.
- `reverseOverlap` (`AIBoolean`): Whether to reverse the overlap of the art. Default is false.
- `clockwiseArc` (`AIBoolean`): Whether the circular arc from `startAngle` to `startAngle + totalAngle` is clockwise. Default is true.
- `mergeState` (`AIRepeatMergeState`): Merge state of the art. Default is `kOverlap`.

axisCenter, axisNormalAngleInRadians, axisRotationAngleInRadians, mergeState.

**AISwatchGroupSuite**  
Hierarchically manages swatch groups.  
Key functions:  
- Group management: `NewSwatchGroup`, `RemoveNthSwatchGroup`, `GetNthSwatchGroup`, `GetSwatchGroupByName`.  
- Swatch operations: `InsertNthSwatch`, `RemoveNthSwatch`, `GetNthSwatch`, `GetSwatchByColor`.  
- Properties: `GetSwatchGroupName`, `SetSwatchGroupName`, `GetSwatchGroupKind`.  
- Reordering: `ReorderSwatch`, `ReorderNthSwatchGroup`.  
- Constraints: First group (index 0) is unnamed and immutable; named groups start at index 1.  
Acquire with `kAISwatchGroupSuite` and `kAISwatchGroupVersion`.
**AISwatchGroupSuite (continued)**  
- `RemoveSwatchGroup(list, swatchGroup, deleteSwatches)`: Removes a swatch group. `deleteSwatches` true deletes member swatches; false moves them to the general group unless duplicates exist. Returns `kBadParameterErr` if group not in list.  
- `ReorderNthSwatch(swatchGroup, fromIndex, toIndex)`: Moves a swatch within a group. `toIndex` -1 moves to end. Returns `kBadParameterErr` for invalid indices.  
- `ReorderNthSwatchGroup(list, fromIndex, newIndex)`: Reorders groups in a list. Cannot move groups to/from index 0. Returns `kBadParameterErr` for invalid indices or if both indices are 0.  
- `ReorderSwatch(swatchGroup, swatch, toIndex)`: Moves a swatch to a new position within its group. `toIndex` -1 moves to end. Returns `kBadParameterErr` for invalid index or if swatch not in group.  
- `ReorderSwatchBetweenGroups(fromGroup, fromIndex, toGroup, toIndex)`: Moves a swatch between groups. `toIndex` -1 appends to destination. Returns `kBadParameterErr` for invalid indices or mismatched lists; `kInvalidSwatchTypeForDest` if swatch type is disallowed.  
- `ReorderSwatchGroup(list, swatchGroup, newIndex)`: Reorders a group by reference. Cannot move general group or to index 0. Returns `kBadParameterErr` for invalid index or if group is general/not in list.  
- `SetSwatchGroupKind(swatchGroup, groupKind)`: Sets the group's kind.  
- `SetSwatchGroupName(swatchGroup, name)`: Sets the group's name (names need not be unique).  
- `SetWantsToBeOpenIfInListView(swatchGroup, whatItWants)`: Sets if the group displays open in list view. Returns `kBadParameterErr` if no group supplied.  
- `SwatchGroupIsInList(list, swatchGroup, indexFoundAt)`: Reports if a group is in a list and returns its index. Returns boolean.  
- `WantsToBeOpenIfInListView(swatchGroup)`: Reports if the group should display open in list view. Returns boolean.

**AISwatchLibraryChangedNotifierData**  
- Structure for `kAISwatchLibraryChangedNotifier`.  
- Fields: `swatchList` (updated list), `swatchLibraryID` (modified library's ID).  

**AISwatchListSuite**  
Accesses/modifies swatches and swatch lists.  
Key functions:  
- List access: `GetSwatchList`, `CountSwatches`.  
- Swatch retrieval: `GetFirstSwatch`, `GetNextSwatch` (deprecated), `GetNthSwatch`, `GetSwatchByName`, `GetSwatchByNameAndType`, `GetSwatchByColor`.  
- Swatch modification: `InsertNthSwatch`, `RemoveNthSwatch`, `RemoveSwatch`, `GetAIColor`, `SetAIColor`, `GetSwatchName`, `SetSwatchName`.  
- Notes: Functions accept `NULL` list for current document. Indices treat groups as flattened; `InsertNthSwatch` index -1 appends to general group.  
- Notifiers: `kAISwatchListChangedNotifier`, `kAISwatchListChangedInternallyNotifier`, `kAISwatchReplaceColorNotifier`.  
Acquire with `kAISwatchListSuite` and `kAISwatchListVersion`.
- **Swatch Retrieval:**
    - `GetNextSwatch()`: **Deprecated.** Inefficient, works only within a single swatch group. Use `CountSwatches()` and `GetNthSwatch()` for iteration.
    - `GetNthSwatch()`: Retrieves by 0-based position index, treating groups as flattened.
    - `GetSwatchByColor()`: Finds the first swatch matching a specified `AIColor`. For patterns/gradients, matches the object, not parameters like matrix.
    - `GetSwatchByName()`: Retrieves a swatch by its name. Returns `NULL` if not found.
    - `GetSwatchByNameAndType()`: Retrieves the first swatch matching a given name and `AIColorTag`.

- **Swatch Modification:**
    - `InsertNthSwatch()`: Creates and inserts a new swatch at a flattened index. Use `SetSwatchName()` and `SetAIColor()` to define it. Index `-1` appends to the general group.
    - `RemoveNthSwatch()`: Removes a swatch by flattened index. If it's the last reference to a custom color, the color is deleted and usages are replaced with process color.
    - `RemoveSwatch()`: Removes a swatch by reference (inefficient). The `deleteCustomColor` flag controls whether underlying custom colors are deleted and usages converted.
    - `GetAIColor()` / `SetAIColor()`: Gets or sets the swatch's color. `SetAIColor()` returns `kInvalidSwatchTypeForDest` if the color type is not allowed in the swatch's group.
    - `GetSwatchName()` / `SetSwatchName()`: Gets or sets the swatch's name. `SetSwatchName()` is limited to 31 characters and renames underlying custom color, pattern, or gradient objects.

- **Swatch List Access:**
    - `GetSwatchList()`: Retrieves the swatch list for a document.

- **Symbol Notifiers & Data:**
    - `AISymbolInstanceDoubleClickedNotifierData`: Struct sent with `kAIArtSymbolDoubleClickedNotifier`, containing the `symbolArt` handle.
    - `AISymbolSetChangeNotifierData`: Struct sent with `kAIArtSymbolSetDetailedChangeNotifier`, providing details for a symbol set change. Contains `timestamp`, `count`, an array of `changedSymbols` (`AIPatternHandle`), and a parallel array of `changeTypes` (`AISymbolChangeType`).

- **AISymbolPaletteSuite:** Accesses symbol currency and selection. Suite is optional (exported by the Symbols palette). Acquire with `kAISymbolPaletteSuite` and `kAISymbolPaletteVersion`.
    - `GetCurrentSymbol()` / `SetCurrentSymbol()`: Gets or sets the current symbol.
    - `IsSymbolSelected()`: Checks if a symbol is selected.
    - `CountSelectedSymbols()` / `GetNthSelectedSymbol()`: Iterates through selected symbols.
    - `IsPaletteVisible()`: Checks if the Symbols palette is visible.
- **AISymbolSuite:** Always available. Queries and manipulates symbol patterns and instances. Symbol instances are art objects of type `kSymbolArt`.
    - **Listed vs. Unlisted Symbols:** Listed symbols appear in the Symbols palette and are saved with the document even if unused. Unlisted symbols are not in the palette and are only saved if used. They are intended for private, automatically generated instances (e.g., for blends or particle systems). Use `MakeSymbolPatternListed()` when expanding such objects.

This suite manages text frame art objects, including point, in-path, and on-path text. It handles text frame properties, linking, and interaction with the Adobe Text Engine (ATE).

-   `NewPointText(paintOrder, prep, orient, anchor, newTextFrame)`: Creates a new point text object.
-   `NewInPathText(paintOrder, prep, orient, path, baseFrame, append, newTextFrame)`: Creates a new in-path text object.
-   `NewOnPathText(paintOrder, prep, orient, path, startT, endT, baseFrame, append, newTextFrame)`: Creates a new on-path text object using start and end path segments.
-   `NewOnPathText2(paintOrder, prep, orient, path, anchor, baseFrame, append, newTextFrame)`: Creates a new on-path text object using an anchor point.
-   `GetType(textFrame, type)`: Retrieves the type of a text frame.
-   `GetOrientation(textFrame, orient)`: Retrieves the orientation of a text frame.
-   `SetOrientation(textFrame, orient)`: Sets the orientation of a text frame.
-   `GetTextAntialias(textFrame, tAntialias)`: Retrieves the antialiasing option.
-   `SetTextAntialias(textFrame, tAntialias)`: Sets the antialiasing option.
-   `GetPointTextAnchor(textFrame, anchor)`: Retrieves the anchor point for point text.
-   `GetPathObject(textFrame, pathObject)`: Retrieves the associated path for in-path or on-path text.
-   `GetOnPathTextTRange(textFrame, startT, endT)`: Retrieves the start and end path segments for on-path text.
-   `SetOnPathTextTRange(textFrame, startT, endT)`: Sets the start and end path segments for on-path text.
-   `GetATETextRange(textFrame, textRange)`: Retrieves the ATE text range for the frame's content.
-   `GetATETextFrame(textFrame, ATE_textFrame)`: Retrieves the ATE text frame object.
-   `GetAITextFrame(ATE_textFrame, textFrame)`: Retrieves the Illustrator art handle from an ATE text frame.
-   `GetATETextSelection(textFrame, Selection)`: Retrieves the ATE text range for the current selection.
-   `DoTextFrameHit(hitRef, textRange)`: Retrieves the ATE text range for a hit-test point.
-   `CreateOutline(textFrame, outline)`: Converts text to outlines in a new art object.
-   `Link(baseFrame, nextFrame)`: Links two text frames.
-   `Unlink(frame, before, after)`: Unlinks a text frame or splits a story.
-   `CreateATEV2Text(paintOrder, prep, data, size, index, newTextFrame)`: Creates a new text frame from ATE version 2 data.
-   `GetATEV2Data(data, size)`: Retrieves the ATE version 2 data for the artwork.
-   `GetStoryIndex(frame, index)`: Retrieves the story index of a text frame.
-   `GetFrameIndex(frame, index)`: Retrieves the frame index of a linked text frame.
-   `PartOfLinkedText(frame, linked)`: Reports whether a text frame is linked.
- `AIThreeColorStyle`: An RGB color.
    - `red`: `AIReal` value for the red component.
    - `green`: `AIReal` value for the green component.
    - `blue`: `AIReal` value for the blue component.
    - `Init()`: Initializes the color components.
- `AIThreeColorStyleMap`: The valid fields of a partial RGB color.
    - `red`: `AIBoolean` indicating if the red field is valid.
    - `green`: `AIBoolean` indicating if the green field is valid.
    - `blue`: `AIBoolean` indicating if the blue field is valid.
    - `Init()`: Initializes the validity flags.
- `AITile`: Describes local storage for copying image data to and from a raster art object.
    - `data`: Pointer to the memory buffer for pixel data.
    - `bounds`: An `AISlice` defining the rectangular area and depth.
    - `rowBytes`: Number of bytes in a row of pixel data.
    - `colBytes`: Number of bytes per pixel.
    - `planeBytes`: Bytes per plane; 0 for interleaved data.
    - `channelInterleave`: Array specifying byte order for pixel transfer.
    - `Init()`: Initializes the tile structure.

- `AIToolDryInkMessage`: The contents of a tool message.
    - `d`: The message data (`SPMessageData`).
    - `flags`: Provides additional information, composed of `AIToolMessageFlags`.
    - `tool`: The tool handle receiving the message.
    - `event`: For future use (e.g., modifiers).
    - `inkStrokes`: An `ai::AutoBuffer` of `AIDocumentInkPoint`.
- `AIToolHitData`: Describes the results of a hit test.
    - `hit`: `AIBoolean`, true if an object was found.
    - `type`: The `AIHitType` of the found object.
    - `subType`: The `AIHitType` of the subtype if the main type is `kFillHitType`.
    - `segment`: The path segment number if the hit is on a path.
    - `object`: The leaf art object that was hit.
    - `group`: The group containing the hit art object.
    - `point`: The exact hit location in page coordinates.
    - `t`: The parametric value on a path segment if the hit was on a segment.
- `AIToolMessage`: The contents of a tool message.
    - `d`: The message data (`SPMessageData`).
    - `tool`: The tool handle receiving the message.
    - `cursor`: The mouse cursor location in page coordinates.
    - `pressure`: The amount of force on a pressure-sensitive device.
    - `event`: The ADM event record for the mouse event (ADM no longer supported).
    - `stylusWheel`: Tangential pressure on an airbrush tool's finger wheel.
    - `tilt`: The angle of the tool (altitude/elevation).
    - `bearing`: The direction of tilt (azimuth).
    - `rotation`: Rotation of the tool around its barrel.
    - `flags`: Provides additional information, composed of `AIToolMessageFlags`.
    - `eventHistoryData`: An `ai::AutoBuffer` of `AIEventHistoryData` associated with the event.
- `AIToolNotifyData`: The contents of a tool notification.
    - `tool`: The tool handle receiving the notification.

This suite allows you to provide plug-in tools for Illustrator, which can work on existing artwork or create new objects. Tools are organized into groups and toolsets in the Tools palette; use `kNoTool` to create new ones. Implement tool behavior by handling selectors (like mouse events) in your plug-in's main function. The tool caller is `kCallerAITool`.

- `AddTool`: Installs a plug-in tool. Use at startup.
- `CountTools`: Gets the number of installed plug-in tools.
- `GetAlternateSelectionToolName`: Retrieves the name of the tool selected by pressing the Ctrl/Cmd key.
- `GetCurrentEffectiveTool`: Retrieves the currently active plug-in tool (NULL for built-in tools).
- `GetCurrentEffectiveToolName`: Retrieves the unique name of the currently active tool.
- `GetCurrentEffectiveToolNumber`: Retrieves the number of the currently active tool.
- `GetCurrentToolName`: Retrieves the unique name of the currently selected tool.
- `GetCurrentToolNumber`: Retrieves the number of the currently selected tool.
- `GetLastUsedSelectionTool`: Retrieves the numerical identifier of the most recently used built-in selection tool.
- `GetNthTool`: Retrieves a tool by its index position.
- `GetSelectedTool`: Retrieves the currently selected plug-in tool (NULL for built-in tools).
- `GetTabletHardwareCapabilities`: Reports the hardware capabilities of a graphics tablet.
- `GetToolHandleFromNumber`: Retrieves a plug-in tool by its tool number.
- `GetToolIcons`: Retrieves the base filenames of the PNG icon resources for a tool.
- `GetToolName`: Retrieves the unique identifying name of a tool. (Use `GetToolTitle()` for the UI title).
- `GetToolNameFromNumber`: Retrieves the unique name of a tool from its number.
- `GetToolNullEventInterval`: Obsolete. Do not use.
- `GetToolNumberFromHandle`: Retrieves a tool number for a tool.

- `GetToolOptionsFromName`: Retrieves options associated with a tool by name.
- `GetToolOptionsFromNumber`: Retrieves options associated with a tool by number.
- `GetToolPlugin`: Retrieves the plug-in that installed a tool.
- `GetTooltip`: Retrieves the tooltip string for a tool.
- `GetToolTitle`: Retrieves the localizable title of a tool.
- `IsSoftModeSelection`: Reports whether there is currently a soft tool selection.
- `SetAlternateSelectionToolName`: Sets the tool temporarily selected by pressing Ctrl/Cmd.
- `SetDocumentInkParams`: Sets the ink parameters for a document.
- `SetSelectedTool`: Selects a plug-in tool programmatically.
- `SetSelectedToolByName`: Selects a tool by its unique name.
- `SetSelectedToolByNumber`: Selects a tool using its tool number.
- `SetSoftSelectedTool`: Selects a plug-in tool without highlighting it in the palette.
- `SetToolIcons`: Sets tool icons for light and dark UI themes.
- `SetToolInfoVars`: Determines which fields are displayed in the Info palette for a tool.
- `SetToolInfoVarValues`: Sets field values in the Info palette.
- `SetToolNullEventInterval`: Obsolete. Do not use.
- `SetToolOptions`: Sets the option flags of a tool.
- `SetTooltip`: Sets the tooltip string for a tool.
- `SetToolTitle`: Sets the localizable title of a tool.
- `SystemHasPressure`: Reports whether a pressure-sensitive device is available.

**AIToolboxMessage** struct contains toolbox message data with fields:
- `d`: Message data
- `toolbox`: Toolbox reference
- `tool`: Tool reference
- `iconResourceDictionary`: Icon shown in Tools palette
- `name`: Unique identifying name for the tool
- `title_deprecated`: Deprecated field (empty string)
- `tooltip_deprecated`: Deprecated field (empty string)
- `helpID_deprecated`: Deprecated field (unused)
- `iconType`: Icon type
- `sameGroupAs`: Internal plugin priority for group
- `sameSetAs`: Internal plugin priority for set
- `isThirdPartyPlugin`: Internal flag for third-party plugins
- `title`: Localized display name for the tool
- `tooltip`: Short descriptive string shown when tool is activated

**AIToolboxSuite** provides functions for creating additional tool palettes:
- `AddToolbox`: Creates a new tool palette
- `AlternateAction`: Performs alternate action for toolbox
- `CountToolboxes`: Gets the number of toolboxes
- `CycleTool`: Cycles through tools in a toolbox
- `GetBuiltInToolboxVisibility`: Gets visibility of built-in toolbox
- `GetCurrentToolType`: Gets the currently selected tool type
- `GetNthToolbox`: Gets a toolbox by index
- `SetTool`: Sets the current tool
- `AddToolbox`: Registers plug-in to receive toolbox selector messages  
- `SetTool`: Makes a tool current for a toolbox (use NULL for built-in toolbox)  
- `AlternateAction`: Performs tool's alternate action (e.g., options dialog)  
- `CycleTool`: Sends `kSelectorAICycleTool` message  
- `CountToolboxes`: Gets number of registered toolboxes  
- `GetNthToolbox`: Retrieves toolbox by index (use with CountToolboxes)  
- `GetCurrentToolType`: Gets currently selected tool type  
- `GetBuiltInToolboxVisibility`: Gets visibility of built-in toolbox  

**AITransformAgainMessage** contains:  
- `d`: Message data  

**AITransformAgainSuite** provides functions for transform operations:  
- `SetTransformAgain`: Registers for `kSelectorAITransformAgain` selector  
- `GetTransformAgain`: Gets plug-in registered for next transform again  

**AITransformArtSuite** provides:  
- `TransformArt`: Transforms art object using matrix (not deep; requires manual traversal for groups)  

**AITrapParameters** attributes:  
- `trapThickness`: Trap thickness in points  
- `heightWidthAspectRatio`: Height-to-width ratio (1.0 = 1:1)  
- `trapTint`: Tint value  
- `maximumTint`: Maximum tint (default recommended)  
- `tintTolerance`: Tint tolerance (default recommended)  
- `reverseTrap`: Nonzero to reverse trap  
- `convertCustomColors`: Nonzero to convert custom colors  
- `Init()`: Initializes members to defaults  

**AIUIDPoolSuite** manages UID name pools:  
- `AddRef`: Increments pool reference count  
- `Release`: Decrements pool reference count (frees at 0)  
- `GetPool`: Retrieves pool by name (currently returns XML pool)  
- `NewUID`: Creates new UID with optional name  
- `GetUID`: Retrieves UID by name  
- `NewUIDREF`: Creates new UID reference with optional name  
- `NewUIDFromBase`: Creates UID with name from base
**AIUIDREFSuite** manages UID references:
- `AddRef`: Increments reference count
- `Release`: Decrements reference count
- `GetContainer`: Retrieves containing dictionary/array
- `GetName`: Retrieves UID name as Unicode string
- `GetPool`: Retrieves name pool
- `GetUID`: Retrieves UID from reference
- `IsInUse`: Reports if UID is stored in a container

**AIUIDSuite** manages unique identifiers:
- `AddRef`: Increments reference count
- `Release`: Decrements reference count
- `GetContainer`: Retrieves containing dictionary/array
- `GetName`: Retrieves UID name as Unicode string
- `GetPool`: Retrieves name pool
- `IsInUse`: Reports if UID is stored in a container
- `NewUIDREF`: Creates new UID reference

**AIUIDUtilsSuite** manages art object UIDs:
- `GetArtUID`: Retrieves art object UID (optionally creates if none)
- `SetArtUID`: Sets/replaces art object UID
- `TransferArtUID`: Transfers UID between art objects (sets source to NULL)
- `NewArtUIDREF`: Gets/creates art UID reference
- `GetReferencedArt`: Retrieves art from UID reference (first frame for text stories)
- `GetArtUIDName`: Retrieves art UID name
- `SetArtUIDName`: Sets art UID name
- `GetArtNameOrUID`: Gets name or XML ID based on user preference
- `SetArtNameOrUID`: Sets name or XML ID based on user preference
- `MakeUIDFromBase`: Creates unique UID from base UID
- `MakeUniqueNameFromBase`: Creates unique name from base name
- `GetStoryUID`: Gets story UID (text frames only, optionally creates)
- `SetStoryUID`: Sets story UID (text frames only)
- `TransferStoryUID`: Transfers story UID between text frames
- `NewStoryUIDREF`: Creates new story UID reference
- `TransferStoryUIDToArt`: Transfers story UID to any art object
- `TransferArtUIDToStory`: Transfers art UID to story
- `FindEquivUID`: Finds source UID for dragged/transformed objects

**AIUIThemeColor** structure:
- Contains RGBA color components (alpha, red, green, blue)
- Constructor with default values (alpha=1.0, RGB=0.0)
**AIUIThemeSuite** suite: Queries UI color and brightness.
- `GetUIThemeColor`: Retrieves a theme color based on theme and component selectors.
- `IsUIThemeDark`: Returns true if the current UI theme is dark.

**AIURLSuite** suite: Opens URLs in a web browser.
- `IsBrowserAvailable`: Returns true if a web browser is available.
- `OpenURL`: Opens the specified URL in a browser.

**AIUUIDSuite** suite: Interacts with UUIDs and associated art (experimental).
- `GetArtHandle`: Retrieves art object for a given UUID.
- `GetArtUUID`: Retrieves UUID for a given art object.
- `UUIDToString`: Converts a UUID to a Unicode string.
- `StringToUUID`: Creates a UUID from a Unicode string.
- `GenerateNewUUID`: Generates a new unique UUID.

**AIUndoNotificationParameters** structure: Contains parameters for undo notifications.
- `fNoOfTransactions`: Number of transactions (`ai::int32`).
- `fDocument`: Document handle (`AIDocumentHandle`).
- Constructor: Initializes with transaction count and document handle.

**AIUndoSuite** suite: Manages undo/redo functionality.
- `SetUndoTextUS`: Sets text for Undo/Redo menu items.
- `SetUndoRedoCmdTextUS`: Sets text for Undo/Redo/History Panel items.
- `MultiUndoTransaction`: Undoes N transactions.
- `MultiRedoTransaction`: Redoes N transactions.
- `UndoChanges`: Undoes changes in the current context.
- `SetActionPaletteUndo`: Undoes Action palette changes.
- `RevertAndForgetLastTransaction`: Undoes and forgets the last transaction.
- `ForgetRedos`: Forgets all redoable transactions.
- `ClearHistory`: Clears all transaction history.
- `SetSilent`: Sets the context as silent (or not).
- `SetKind`: Sets the context type (`AIUndoContextKind`).
- `CountTransactions`: Counts available undo/redo transactions.
- `IsSilent`: Reports if the context is silent.
- `SetTagUS`: Sets a tag for the current transaction.
- `GetTagUS`: Gets the tag for the current transaction.
- `SetNthTransactionTagUS`: Sets a tag for a transaction by index.
- `GetNthTransactionTagUS`: Gets a tag for a transaction by index.
- `SetRecordingSuspended`: Suspends undo recording (internal use).
- `IsRecordingSuspended`: Reports if recording is suspended (internal use).
- *Context Handling*: Illustrator creates an undo context for each plug-in selector. `UndoChanges()` only affects the current context. Context types include standard (adds a new transaction) and silent (skipped during undo/redo). Plug-ins can modify context type if not nested.

**AIUnicodeStringSuite** suite: Manipulates Unicode strings.
- Functions: `Append`, `AppendSubString`, `Assign`, `CanonicalCaseCompare`, `CanonicalCompare`, `Capacity`, `CaseCompare`, `CaseCompareSubString`, `CaseFindSubString`, `Clear`, `Compare`, `CompareSubString`, `Copy`, `Destroy`, `Empty`, `Erase`, `FindChar`, `FindFirstNotOf`, `FindFirstOf`, `FindLastNotOf`, `FindLastOf`, `FindString`, `FindSubString`, `GetAs`, `GetChar`, `HasSurrogates`, `Initialize`, `InitializeUTF16`, `InitializeUTF32Char`, `InitializeZString`, `Length`, `Normalize`, `Reserve`, `Resize`, `RFindChar`, `RFindString`, `RFindSubString`, `SubStr`, `SwapStr`, `toLower`, `toUpper`, `UTF_16`.
**AIUpdateBezier**: Not used.
- Members: `p0` (initial knot point), `p1` (first control point), `p2` (second control point), `p3` (final knot point), `updateIt` (true to update an existing annotation), `drawIt` (true to draw a new annotation).

**AIUpdateFileFormatMessage**:
- Members: `art`, `data`, `ffm`.
**AIUpdateFileFormatMessage**: Obsolete - linked raster art is now implemented as placed art. Message structure for `kSelectorAIUpdateFileFormat`.
- Members: `art` (AIArtHandle, the art object to be updated), `data` (void*, a pointer to the update data, not used, always `NULL`), `ffm` (struct AIFileFormatMessage, the message data).

**AIUpdatePathStyleNotifyData**: Data for `kAIUpdatePathStyleNotifier`.
- Members: `pathStyle` (AIPathStyle, path style to update), `pathStyleMap` (AIPathStyleMap, indicates which fields of a path style are specified).

**AIUserSuite**: Provides utility functions for unit conversion, progress bars, file dialogs, alerts, date/time, application interaction, naming, and more.

|  | |  |  |  |  |  | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [Contents](index.html) | [Suites](group___suites.html) | [Classes](annotated.html) | [Class Index](classes.html) | [Member Index](functions.html) |  AIUserSuite Struct Reference

This suite provides utility functions for Illustrator, including unit conversion and progress bar functionality.

`#include <AIUser.h>`

Acquire this suite using `SPBasicSuite::AcquireSuite()` with constants `kAIUserSuite` and `kAIUserSuiteVersion`.

### Public Attributes

**Progress Functions**
- `AIBoolean(* Cancel)(void)` - Reports if user canceled operation
- `void(* UpdateProgress)(ai::int32 current, ai::int32 max)` - Updates progress bar
- `void(* SetUpdateProgressCallback)(UpdateProgressProc func)` - Registers progress callbacks
- `void(* SetProgressText)(const ai::UnicodeString &text)` - Sets progress bar text
- `void(* CloseProgress)(void)` - Closes progress bar
- `void(* DisableProgressCancel)(void)` - Disables cancel button in progress bar

**Unit Conversion Functions**
- `void(* AIRealToString)(AIReal value, ai::int16 precision, ai::UnicodeString &string)` - Converts points to string using period decimal separator

- `void(* IUAIRealToString)(AIReal value, ai::int16 precision, ai::UnicodeString &string)` - Converts points to string using localized IU decimal separator
- `void(* IUAIRealToStringWithLocale)(AIReal value, ai::int16 precision, ai::UnicodeString &string, const ai::LocaleID locale)` - Converts points to string with document scale and locale
- `void(* IUAIRealToStringWithLocaleWithoutScale)(AIReal value, ai::int16 precision, ai::UnicodeString &string, const ai::LocaleID locale)` - Converts points to string with locale (no scale)
- `void(* IUStringToAIReal)(const ai::UnicodeString &string, AIReal *value)` - Converts string to AIReal using IU decimal separator

- `AIErr(* IUAIRealToStringUnitsWithoutScale)(AIReal value, ai::int32 precision, ai::UnicodeString &string)` - Converts points to formatted string with units (no scale)

**AIVectorizeSuite**
Accesses the tracing art object model, which includes a source image, a tracing result, options, and internal state. A tracing preset is a named collection of state information.
- `AIErr(* CreateTracing)(ai::int16, AIArtHandle, AIArtHandle, AIArtHandle*)` - Creates a tracing group from raster or foreign object art.
- `AIBoolean(* IsTracing)(AIArtHandle)` - Reports if an art object is a tracing group.
- `AIErr(* GetSourceImage)(AIArtHandle, AIArtHandle*)` - Retrieves the source art of a tracing group.
- `AIErr(* CopyTracingArt)(AIArtHandle, ai::int16, AIArtHandle, AIArtHandle*, AIBool8)` - Copies the tracing result art into the current document.
- `AIErr(* AcquireTracingOptions)(AIArtHandle, AIDictionaryRef*)` - Retrieves the tracing options dictionary.
- `AIErr(* AcquireTracingStatistics)(AIArtHandle, AIDictionaryRef*)` - Retrieves the read-only tracing statistics dictionary.
- `AIErr(* EmbedSwatches)(AIArtHandle)` - Embeds swatches in the tracing result.
- `AIErr(* Update)(AIArtHandle)` - Creates the tracing result from the source art.
- `AIErr(* GetNativeResolution)(AIArtHandle, AIReal*)` - Retrieves the native resolution of an art object.
- `AIErr(* GetEffectiveResolution)(AIArtHandle, AIReal*)` - Retrieves the effective resolution of a tracing object.
- `AIErr(* SetSourceArtChanged)(AIArtHandle, AIBoolean)` - Marks or unmarks a tracing art object as changed for reprocessing.
- `AIErr(* GetImageClass)(AIArtHandle, ai::int32&)` - Retrieves the image classifier output class.
- `AIErr(* GetImageClassPresetStr)(AIArtHandle, ai::UnicodeString&)` - Retrieves the image classifier output class mapped preset string.

**AIWebPEncodeOptions**
Options for encoding WebP files.

- `ai::uint8 mImageQuality` - Quality for lossy compression (0-100).
- `AIBool8 mIsTransparent` - Include alpha channel.
- `AIBool8 mEmbedICCProfile` - Embed ICC color profile.
- `AIBool8 mIncludeXMPMetadata` - Include XMP metadata.
- `AIWebPEncodeAntiAlias mAntiAlias` - Anti-aliasing technique for rasterizing.
- `AIReal mPPI` - Image resolution in pixels-per-inch.
- `AIRGBColor mMatteColor` - Background color if image is not transparent.

- `AIErr(* GetBooleanValue)(AIWorkspaceHandle, const char*, const char*, AIBoolean*)` - Gets a boolean value.
- `AIErr(* SetBooleanValue)(AIWorkspaceHandle, const char*, const char*, AIBoolean)` - Sets a boolean value.
